title: Use-evidence contact-log entry (OTCS-0007)
description: One party contacted about evidence of use. The log exists BEFORE any approach ever happens — that ordering is the point: an instance from a contacted party qualifies only if its log entry predates the party's artifact, so selection is auditable. Identity is redacted here by construction.

contact_id.description: Stable id, assigned in file order, never reused.

date.description: When the approach happened. Committed before any instance from this party can qualify.

channel.description: The kind of channel — 'email', 'direct message', 'issue tracker'. Never the address itself.

party_ref.description: A stable opaque reference, never a name or handle. The same party keeps the same ref across contacts. If they later publish an instance themselves, the instance names them as THEY choose; this log never does.

initiated_by.description: Who opened the exchange. A party arriving on their own is recorded too — it makes the no-solicitation claim checkable in both directions.

about.description: What was asked or offered, in one sentence.

outcome.description: What happened — 'no reply', 'declined', 'said they would look', 'published an artifact (see instance)'.
